title: ‘Tuloy ang laban’: PISTON bids farewell to Tatay Elmer
summary: Every day, Elvira rode alongside her husband, Elmer Cordero, fondly known as “Tatay Elmer,” as he drove their jeepney from Caloocan to Manila to earn a living.
